title: Special Topics in Historic Preservation; Computer Lab for Preservation
description: In this course, students will be introduced to a wide array of computational and digital tools that are becoming essential parts of the Preservation toolkit in the 21st century. Students will also complete a project that goes beyond the basics introduced in class, diving deep into a tool or technique like the digitization and analysis of historical documents, site mapping, scanning, AutoCAD drawings, or historical BIM development.
